description: Gift a shop pack to another player (any kingdom), paid with this account's store credit, exactly like the shop's gift button with store credit (POST /v1/iap/gift). Find the player with find_players. To pay with real money instead, use buy_pack with gift_to_account_id. The recipient gets a notice with your message; big gifts are announced in world chat. A gift is the pack at its listed price, with a daily cap.

message.description: optional message shown with the gift (max 200 characters)

to_account_id.description: the recipient's account_id, from find_players (preferred: names can repeat)

to_display_name.description: or the recipient's exact display name

name: gift_pack
title: Gift a pack (real money)
